page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, this virtual machine runs on the KVM hypervisor and features 32 shared vCPUs. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 12.0 GB per core.

The primary hardware feature of this instance is its integrated graphics acceleration, consisting of three NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture. These GPUs deliver a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM. This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning storage resources must be attached externally. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of 32 vCPUs with three enterprise-grade NVIDIA L4 GPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM offers a dense resource profile for specialized workloads without the overhead of dedicated physical hardware. The shared CPU allocation represents a tradeoff for workloads that require sustained, non-burstable CPU performance, but it remains highly cost-effective for GPU-bound tasks. This server is suited for machine learning inference, data science jobs, video transcoding, and large-scale parallel processing workloads.
